guitar.evidence: Noel Hogan of The Cranberries used various Fender and Gibson guitars; no single iconic signature model widely documented.
guitar.notes: Filled in guitarist name with low confidence on specific gear.

tone.summary: A shimmering, jangly arpeggiated sound achieved with a clean boost, Chorus modulation, and a Vox-style amp into a 2x12 cabinet, topped with light reverb.

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Slightly lift the signal and add brightness for jangle.
blocks.gap: Using Boost instead of a dedicated clean OD to maintain transparency.

blocks.purpose: Keep the tone completely clean and transparent.
Avoid the wah effect as per the musical verdict.
Create the signature shimmering, watery jangle sound.
Simulate the bright, clean Fender/Vox style tone.
Provide a bright, articulate sound suitable for clean arpeggios.
Enhance the bright top end and cut unnecessary muddiness.
blocks.gap: Using a dedicated EQ to fine-tune the high frequencies required for 'airy' sound.

blocks.purpose: Add light, airy ambience without washing out the jangle.
blocks.gap: Plate reverb is excellent for clean, shimmering tones.

blocks.purpose: Optional: Keep delay off to maintain focus on the chorus and arpeggios.

improvements.summary: Enhance cabinet realism for a more authentic Vox/Fender clean jangle sound.

proposals.reason: Better captures the classic Vox chime and airiness needed for 'Dreams' arpeggios.
